content.text:
I submitted **index 2 (Sb fraction 0.27)** as the best composition; its measured EQE was 0.0076%. I used all 5 EQE measurements and none of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.19 | 0.0020 |
| **2** | **0.27** | **0.0076** |
| 4 | 0.36 | 0.0046 |
| 12 | 0.50 | 0.00054 |
| 22 | 0.67 | 0.00024 |

- **Where the peak is:** the lead-rich side does best. EQE peaks around Sb 0.25–0.30 and drops on both sides.
- **Antimony-rich side:** compositions near the known Pb2Sb2O7 (Sb 0.50) and PbSb2O6 (Sb 0.67) phases gave almost no photoresponse under the 2.1 eV light. That fits these phases having band gaps too wide to absorb it, but I didn't confirm which phases are actually present.
- **Last measurement:** it went to index 4 (Sb 0.36), which the Gaussian-process model ranked highest. It came in lower than index 2.
- **Unmeasured neighbours:** index 1 (Sb 0.22) and index 3 (Sb 0.30) could still be slightly higher than index 2. The model's estimate for index 3 was about 0.0073%, roughly equal to index 2.
